Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR JIG FOOT BOLTS 



( Reaffirmed 2001 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and other requirements for jig foot bolts used with jig foot nuts 
according to IS : 11843-1986 'Specification for jig foot nuts'.

Note 1 — The length of the plug from the shoulder including both the under cut shall be less than the thickness of 
the jig plate. 

Note 2 — Dimensional deviations for untoleranced dimensions: Medium class according to IS : 2102 ( Part 1 )- 
1980 'General tolerances for dimensions and form and positions: Part 1 General tolerances for linear and angular 
dimensions ( second revision )\ 



3. Threads — Shall be 6 g class as per IS : 4218 'ISO m.etric screw threads'. 

4. Material — Steel having tensile strength of 370 WlPa, Min. 

4.1 The chamfered face of diameter rfi, if agreed to between the n\anufacturer and the user, shall be 
hardened to 550 HV, Min,

5. Designation — A jig foot bolt having di = 20 mm and / = 100 mm shall be designated as: 

Jig Foot Bolt 20 X 100 IS: 11831 

6. Finish — The jig foot bolts shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

7. Preservation and Packing 

7.1 A suitable anti- corrosive surface treatment shall be given to jig foot bolts. 

7.2 Jig foot bolts shall be packed in suitable cartons so as to prevent damage during transit. 

8. Marking — The cartons containing the jig foot bolts shall be marked with designation and the 
manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

8.1. Certification Marldng— Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from BS : 5078 - 1974 'Specification 
for jig and fixture components : Table 41 jig foot bolts, steel' issued by the British Standards 

Institution.
